rules:
// CODIGO INICIATIVA: INIT-55
// DESCRIPCION: when itemizado dentro de where
// RESPONSIBLE: qa
// VERSION: 1.0.0

events:
    // Prepara el estado del filtro
    &OnlyActive = nullvalue(0)
    for each Customer
        where CustomerStatus = &OnlyActive
        when &OnlyActive = 1
        when &OnlyActive = 2
        defined by CustomerIdx
    endfor // Customer
